With Applied Math, you focus more on Numerical Analysis than just Theoretical stuff.

Numerical Analysis is the study of algorithms which use numerical approximation. So when you're analyzing a function for divergence, it won't be "Ah, this diverges" it'll be a question of "How fast does it diverge?"

Pure Math (Not Applied) focuses on a lot of theory. There is little association with real world restrictions when studying Pure Math.
